tasks.label: Preview NGC website
args: const http = require("node:http"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const path = require("node:path"); const files = { "/": ["index.html", "text/html"], "/index.html": ["index.html", "text/html"], "/app.js": ["app.js", "text/javascript"], "/config.js": ["config.js", "text/javascript"], "/styles.css": ["styles.css", "text/css"] }; http.createServer((req, res) => { const file = files[new URL(req.url, "http://127.0.0.1:8080").pathname]; if (!Array.isArray(file)) { res.writeHead(404); res.end("Not found"); return; } fs.readFile(path.join(process.cwd(), "web", file[0]), (err, data) => { if (err) { console.error(err); res.writeHead(500); res.end("Unable to read file"); return; } res.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": file[1] + "; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store" }); res.end(data); }); }).listen(8080, "127.0.0.1", () => console.log("NGC preview: http://127.0.0.1:8080/#/partner"));
